data.name: Dhakir
data.gender_notes: Dhakir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'dh-k-r', which means 'to remember' or 'to commemorate'. In Islamic tradition, Dhakir refers to the one who remembers and keeps the remembrance of Allah (swt) in their heart, mind, and actions. The name Dhakir carries the meaning “Remembrance, Commemoration” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dhakir usually hope their child will grow to embody remembrance, commemoration and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A constant reminder of Allah in one's heart and actions.
data.etymology: Dhakir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Remembrance, Commemoration.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhakir total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Dhakir
in_english.long_meaning: Dhakir is an Arabic name that means 'one who remembers Allah' or 'one who is mindful of God'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'ذ-ك-ر' which means 'to remember' or 'to mention'. The name Dhakir has been mentioned in the Quran, such as in the verse {And the men who remember Allah much}. It signifies a person who frequently remembers and acknowledges God's presence in their life.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dhakir holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world as it emphasizes the idea of remembering Allah (swt) in all aspects of life. The practice of Dhikr (remembrance of Allah) is a fundamental spiritual discipline in Islam, and the naming of a child as Dhakir serves as a constant reminder and inspiration for them to stay steadfast on the path of faith and piety.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Dhakir has profound spiritual significance, as it represents one's deep connection with the divine. By serving as a reminder to remember Allah (swt) at all times, the name Dhakir bestows upon the bearer the blessings of closeness to the Creator. It implies a strong spiritual foundation, with a consistent focus on remembrance and devotion, rendering the individual a valuable asset to society and a virtuous soul in the hereafter.
